senses.gloss:
(ऋ) लपृ r. 1st cl. (लपति)
To speak, to utter.
With अनु prefixed,
1 To talk like, to mimic.
2 To repeat.
With अप,
To deny.
With आङ्,
To address, to speak to.
With प्र,
To talk incoherently^1.
With प्रति,
To gain, to get.
With वि,
To lament, to bewail.
With वि and प्र,
To contradict, to dispute.
With सम,
1 To converse, to discourse.
2 To be cunning or crafty.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-पः)
Speaking, talking.
E.
लप to speak, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 The mouth.
2 Talking.
E.
लप to speak, ल्युट् aff. of the instrument or act.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spoken, said.
n. (-तं)
Voice or speech.
E.
लप to speak, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
To be said or spoken.
E.
लप to speak, aff. ण्यत्.
